sentence.text: Many plants end their long winter sleep and form new buds and shoots.
sentence.title: 'Watching the Grass Grow' Is Not Fun
sentence.credit_line: Anna Matteo wrote this story for VOA Learning English.

dialogue.title: Let's Learn English - Level 2 - Lesson 1: Budget Cuts
dialogue.note: Turns 1-6 of the Anna/Jonathan exchange, verbatim; typographic quotes changed to straight quotes.

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: So, Jonathan, what do you think today's meeting is about? The email sounded important.

turns.speaker: Jonathan
turns.text: Well, I have heard people in the building talking about budget cuts.

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Oh! Budget cuts? Wait, who has been talking about budget cuts?

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.text: Mark in Accounting? That's one person. That's not "people."

turns.speaker: Jonathan
turns.text: I know, but Mark knows everything that goes on at The Studio.
